budgetRationale: Re-pinned for three Commit Graph quick fixes (#5352, #5607, #2925): the entrypoint grows +9.2 KiB against the Review Changes pin, but only about 0.6 KiB of it is this change (graph.js +0.25 KiB, graph.css +0.39 KiB): main measured 3,257,438 bytes at caaf7ef (and the same at 1e435c5), inside its ceiling, so +8.5 KiB (mostly graph.js) had already accrued there since 2e2557e. This change's bytes are Compare Working Tree to Here using a commit, stash or tag row's own ref; the Changes column opt-in overlay's shrinkable spacers and size container queries that drop its help copy and Hide link whole on a short rows area; and the hidden branches/tags popover's capped, scrollable list with the shared scrollbar styles. Not a new dependency or a module moving between chunks. Ceilings keep their prior headroom: 12 KiB above baseline on the entrypoint, 4 KiB on shared.js (loaded by every webview), and graph.css's accounted allowance.
